thread:
Mia: Hey — spotted a partner ingest containing a KMS-wrapped blob and a plaintext Vault path in the same log line. tagging sec-oncall for containment. not sure if blob is exfil or just logs.
Anna: Ugh. Can you paste the log snippet (redact actual ciphertext)? we need to confirm wrap key scope and affected SA.
Mia: pasted minimal snippet: `2026-03-21T01:12:32Z partner-ingest INFO blob_id=abc123 wrapped_kms_key=projects/partner/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/ckey vault_path="secret/data/prod/redis/creds"` — ciphertext removed.
Anna: Thanks. That Vault path implies we may have service credentials referenced. First step: block partner's service account keys from reading vault transit/unseal roles. Josh — can you run a temporary RBAC deny for the partner SA across vault-proxy?
Josh: On it. I'll apply a deny rule to the service account used by partner-ingest in staging and prod proxies. ETA 10m.
sec-oncall-bot: runbook: https://internal/runbooks/secrets-leak-containment — created incident INC-2026-031. Assigned: eng-security.
Priya: Before revoking keys, can we snapshot which Vault secrets were referenced by that path? if it's a template (e.g. `secret/data/<env>/redis/creds`) partner may have had templated reads across many tenants.
Mia: Agreed. I queried Vault audit (last 30d) for reads under `secret/data/prod/redis/creds` — found 42 reads from our services + 3 reads from partner SA.
Anna: Ok scope looks limited to that path. Two parallel workstreams: 1) Contain external SA (Josh) 2) Rotate secrets and rewrap with new KMS key / rebind policies (Mia/Priya). We also need to forward audit logs to the security SIEM for correlation.
Josh: Deny applied to partner SA on proxy-roles, verified via `gcloud iam policies get` and Vault proxy logs show 403s now.
Priya: For rotation I'm proposing a 3-step plan:
- create new KMS key (ckey-rot-2026-03-21) with restricted IAM (only our vault-service-sa + eng-security rewrap role)
- rewrap existing ciphertext blobs with the new key using `gcloud kms rewrap` (canary key test on one blob)
- rotate vault secret versions and update consumers via staged rollout (canary consumers first)
Priya: Example rewrap command (canary):
```
gcloud kms keys versions encrypt --key=ckey-rot-2026-03-21 --location=global --keyring=ring --plaintext-file=- < wrapped-blob > new-wrapped-blob
```
Anna: Slight tweak — we should never decrypt ciphertext in the clear on local disk. Use server-side rewrap where possible: `gcloud kms keys versions rewrap` (we have role to rewrap). Also enable CMEK logs to SIEM.
Mia: Good catch. I'll prepare the KMS key policy doc and list of service identities that need access. Also request HSM-backed key.
Anna: Timeline: containment done. Next window for rotation: 02:00–04:00 UTC tonight to minimize traffic. We will run rewrap canary on one blob, rotate the Vault secret versions, then monitor telemetry for 30m before broadening.
Josh: I'll prepare RBAC rollback plan in case partner SA deny causes dependent jobs to fail. will whitelist any internal service accidentally blocked.
Priya: I'll prepare an automation script to rotate Vault secret versions and update consumers via our config-reload hook. Script will support dry-run and `--canary` flag.
Mia: Also need an audit-forward step: push proxy logs + KMS admin events to SIEM index `sec-secrets-leak-2026`. Can someone open the forwarder ticket?
Anna: I'll open it and add required parsers for KMS `rewrap` and Vault `rotate` events.
sec-oncall-bot: update: incident INC-2026-031 severity P2. containment: partner SA denies in place. next: KMS key creation and canary rewrap.
Mia: After rotation, we'll run an ownership sweep to retire any long-lived service tokens that had access. I'll create a PR with the list.
Priya: Post-rotation validation checklist (short):
- canary consumer can still read updated secret version
- CI jobs referencing old key fail-safe and have fallback (shouldn't auto-run)
- SIEM shows no outgoing exfil anomalies tied to partner IPs
Anna: Good. Let's sync at 01:30 UTC for pre-window check. If anything blocks, escalate to oncall lead.
Mia: thanks all — I'll paste the KMS policy and the list of Vault paths into INC-2026-031 and update as we go. :thumbsup:
Josh: I'll keep watching proxy dashboards and post any 5xxs here.
Priya: I'll drop the canary script link once ready.
Anna: Closing loop: once rewrap + rotate + sweep complete, we will require partner to rotate their client keys and sign an attestation.
Mia: noted. ping me if you need any access or tokens for testing.
sec-oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-031 updated: runbook step 4 (rewrap) started at 01:58 UTC.
